prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production transparent game symbol for Wild Pickins. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: reproduce its hand-painted carved wood material, chunky rounded slab lettering, thick honey-brown bevel, visible grain, gently chipped paint, warm upper-left lighting and substantial downward wooden extrusion. Generate ONLY the exact character "10" as one standalone centered symbol, front-facing and upright, no rotation or lean (runtime will rotate 3 degrees). Paint the broad front face sage green #83A66A, keep wooden bevel and thick sidewalls natural honey brown.
